# Jagran Josh

> > Jagran Josh is India's leading education and career portal providing exam updates, results, admit cards, study materials, and competitive exam preparation resources for students and job seekers.

The platform covers major competitive exams (UPSC, Railway RRB, SSC), board examinations (CBSE, ICSE, state boards), college admissions (CUET, PGIMER), government recruitment notifications, and general knowledge resources. Content is available in both English and Hindi to serve India's diverse student population.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Civil Services Examination
- Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
- CBSE Board Exams
- ICSE & CISCE Examinations
- Government Job Recruitment
- Bihar State Exams & Results
- CUET UG Admissions
- Exam Preparation & Mock Tests
- Board Exam Results
- Admit Card Downloads
- Question Papers & Answer Keys
- Sarkari Result Updates
- Competitive Exam Schedules
- State Board Examinations
- General Knowledge & Current Affairs
